rationale: MOQ of b raised to 15 while each batch needs 10 and b lives 40 days with 50% required at use: one order cannot serve two batches four weeks apart, so every batch forces a 15-unit order and at least 15 units are left over. Cost rises by about 15 x 2,600 USD to 239,000-250,000 USD.
falsifier: Refuted if fewer than 15 units are left over in the cost-optimal plan, or its cost falls outside 239,000-250,000 USD.
